items.title: Hollinger POTD Michael Redd. Ohio St SG drafted 43rd by MIL in 00. Played only 6 gms as rook but evolved to 6th man in 01-02. Started in 03-04 & had 21+ ppg thru 2010 (peak 26.7 ppg in 06-07). Injured in 09, basically ending career. Per bio, really wanted that "and 1" call.
